get.description:
Records accepted and rejected (by signal and reason) per minute, summed over the
service's keys; newest minute first. Default window: the last hour; at most 24 h.
Liveness: the process is up and serving. Makes no dependency calls.
Readiness: Postgres and Redis reachable. 503 with per-dependency status otherwise.
